BERENGAR CAME BACK THE NEXT NIGHT AND READ IT. _ SHORTLY AFTER, SUFFERING TERRIBLE PAINS, HE TRIED TO TAKE A SOOTHING BATH AND DROWNED. _ HIS FINGERS AND TONGUE, TOO, WERE BLACKENED. _ SEVERINUS FOUND THE BOOK THAT BERENGAR HAD HIDDEN IN THE INFIRMARY. BUT MALACHI KILLED HIM AND TOOK THE BOOK. _ AFTER READING IT, HE AGONIZINGLY MADE HIS WAY TO THE CHURCH, WHERE HE DIED. _ ALL OF THEM DIED FROM A BOOK THAT KILLS, OR ONE THROUGH WHICH MEN KILL.@3 I DON'T FIND ANYTHING IN YOUR DARK DISCOURSE THAT SHEDS SOME LIGHT ON WHAT HAS HAPPENED. _ YOUR TIME IS OVER. YOU MUST STOP YOUR INVESTIGATION. _ TOMORROW YOU WILL LEAVE THE ABBEY.
